info.title: dotnetjq
info.description: jq 1.8.2-compatible command-line processor backed by DotNetJq.

options.name: --null-input
options.description: use `null` as the single input value;

options.name: --raw-input
options.description: read each line as string instead of JSON;

options.name: --slurp
options.description: read all inputs into an array and use it as one value;

options.name: --compact-output
options.description: compact instead of pretty-printed output;

options.name: --raw-output
options.description: output strings without escapes and quotes;

options.name: --raw-output0
options.description: implies -r and outputs NUL after each output;

options.name: --join-output
options.description: implies -r and omits output newlines;

options.name: --ascii-output
options.description: escape non-ASCII output characters;

options.name: --sort-keys
options.description: sort object keys on output;

options.name: --color-output
options.description: colorize JSON output;

options.name: --monochrome-output
options.description: disable colored output;

options.name: --tab
options.description: use tabs for indentation;

options.name: --indent
options.description: use n spaces for indentation (maximum 7);

options.name: --unbuffered
options.description: flush after each output;

options.name: --stream
options.description: parse input in streaming fashion;

options.name: --stream-errors
options.description: implies --stream and emits parse errors as arrays;

options.name: --seq
options.description: use application/json-seq framing and recovery;

options.name: --from-file
options.description: load the filter from a file;

options.name: --library-path
--args
options.description: collect remaining arguments as strings;

options.name: --jsonargs
options.description: collect remaining arguments as JSON values;

options.name: --exit-status
options.description: set exit status based on the final output;

options.name: --binary
options.description: request binary standard streams on Windows;

options.name: --version
options.description:
show the version;
--build-configuration show the managed build configuration;

options.name: --help
